[size=4]Transform your Stardew Valley experience into a spine-chilling adventure with Bats & Crows: Creepy Critters! This mod utilizes the Custom Critters framework to add eerie bats and ominous crows that fly around both day and night, enhancing the atmosphere with a touch of horror. Perfect for those who love a spooky twist in their gameplay![/size][/font]
[font=Georgia]

[b][u]Features[/u][/b][/font][font=Georgia][b]
Bats[/b]: Watch as these nocturnal creatures flutter through the sky, adding an eerie ambiance to your farm and surroundings.
[/font][font=Georgia][b]Crows[/b]: These ominous birds make appearances, contributing to the creepy and unsettling vibe of the game.
[font=Georgia][b]24/7 Activity[/b]: Both critters are active during their respective times, ensuring a continuous spooky presence in your game.[/font]
[b]
If you would like to adjust the times and spawn amount, please see the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26071?tab=posts&BH=1] pinned post[/url]﻿.[/b]


[img]https://imgur.com/WIj4nRN.png[/img]﻿
[/font]
[b]Download and Install Custom Critters[/b]:
Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url]﻿
Extract the Custom Critters folder into your Mods folder.[font=Georgia][b]

[/b][/font]Download this mod and extract the [b]ashleyketchumtr.batscrows[/b] folder.into the [b]Critters folder[/b] within the[b] Custom Critters[/b] mod directory.[font=Georgia][list=1]

[/list][/font]Ensure the entire [b]Custom Critters folder (with the Creepy Critters mod included) [/b]is placed in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
The file layout should look like this:
[b]Custom Critters / Critters / ashleyketchumtr.batscrows[/b][font=Georgia][list=1]
